description: Main entry point for a Flutter application named 'Admin Panel'. It initializes Flutter bindings, attempts to load environment variables from a '.env' file, and runs the application with a MaterialApp containing an AppShell widget.

classes.name: AdminPanelApp
classes.description: Root widget for the Admin Panel application, a StatelessWidget that builds a MaterialApp with specified theme and home widget.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Asynchronous main function that initializes Flutter, loads environment variables, and launches the Admin Panel app.

methods.name: AdminPanelApp.build
methods.description: Builds and returns the MaterialApp widget configured for the Admin Panel.
